# Acer Belgium PHN16-I71 power and support

- Acer Belgium's current GPU table states `PHN16-I71 + RTX 5080` at 150W base plus 25W Dynamic Boost, for 175W maximum graphics power. This is family-level Belgian evidence, not an exact Belgian retail SKU.
- Exact Acer Care Plus code `SV.WNGAM.001` costs €79.90 including VAT, is in stock, and extends eligible Predator/Nitro/Aspire 7 notebooks to three-year carry-in with first-year international warranty.
- The plan must be activated within 365 days. Acer instructs buyers to verify compatibility by serial number, so compatibility with an imported Dutch exact SKU remains `UNKNOWN` until the serial/accessory checker accepts it.
- Acer Belgium's standard Predator notebook coverage is two-year pickup and return.
